limitations: only the file:line kind is truth-checked; migration and bare git-show keep block-level presence via the legacy _EVIDENCE_RE predicate
the check verifies a cited line holds the quoted text, not that the text supports the claim drawn from it
pairing is scoped to the whole Locked-Decisions region, not per-LD
working-tree evidence is checked at lint time, not as of authoring
non_goals: per-LD pairing granularity: LDs are bold spans not headings
promoting the lint to a binding VETO
changing the BEHAVIOR of check_plan warnings; construction sites change because kind is required with no default and carries one of five values

open_questions: Does the span-based exclusion mask a legitimate prose citation? Resolved by a Phase 2 test; note dedup rather than span exclusion reduces this plan's own ten occurrences to five, so the fixture is the sole coverage for the span rule.
Does reason wording constrain the implementation? Yes - the existing suite asserts 'evidence' in reason.lower().
phases: Phase 1: parse and resolve an evidence statement -- qor/scripts/plan_grep_lint.py (EvidenceStatement, parse_evidence_statements, resolve_line, reproduces), tests/test_plan_grep_evidence_parse.py, five tests/fixtures/evidence_*.md

Phase 2: pair each citation with its own evidence, dedup by (path,line), LintWarning.kind required with five values across three producers, ceiling line to stderr; tests/test_plan_grep_citation_pairing.py; MODIFY tests/test_plan_grep_lint_citation_evidence.py
Phase 3: doctrine and glossary -- doctrine-shadow-genome-countermeasures.md P1 paragraph, glossary.md, docs/GOVERNANCE_INDEX.md, tests/test_doctrine_citation_pairing.py
